rubric.role_summary: Senior in-house counsel leading a two-person legal team and owning commercial partnership and joint-venture transactions for a waste management and carbon removal company, from term sheets through negotiation and post-closing amendments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior in-house counsel leading a two-person legal team and owning commercial partnership and joint-venture transactions for a waste management and carbon removal company, from term sheets through negotiation and post-closing amendments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- J.D. from an accredited law school.
- 8+ years of transactional experience in energy, infrastructure, environmental/waste, or project development, at a major law firm, in-house at a sponsor/developer, or both.
- Experience drafting and negotiating JV agreements or comparable complex commercial agreements.
- Experience managing and reviewing the work of junior attorneys and/or paralegals.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with waste management, environmental services, or adjacent industries.
- Familiarity with environmental liability frameworks (RCRA, CERCLA, state waste regulation) and how they drive contract terms.
- Exposure to project finance structures (SPVs, lender consent rights, collateral assignment of material contracts).
- Experience at a venture-backed or growth-stage company.
- First-chair experience drafting and negotiating JV agreements or comparable complex commercial arrangements without outside counsel support.
- Commercial risk-allocation expertise covering indemnities, limitations of liability, insurance requirements, force majeure, and default and termination mechanics.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater Houston, TX area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
